headline: Walmart lets shoppers buy through Meta's Muse AI agent
body: Walmart is teaming up with Meta to let customers shop its Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta's AI agent, in a partnership announced Tuesday. Walmart says Muse does not get access to a customer's Walmart shopping history or other personal information, and shoppers can set spending limits and require approval before purchases.
note: Walmart's Agent Gateway lets outside AI assistants connect to its online store, and the spending limits and purchase approvals are the controls a payments team would look for in agent checkout.

evidence.text: Walmart is the latest retailer making that shift, teaming up with Meta to let customers shop its Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.
The partnership, announced Tuesday, gives shoppers another way to find products, compare prices, and make purchases without browsing Walmart’s website themselves.
Walmart says it has built privacy protections into the experience.
For instance, Muse doesn’t get access to a customer’s Walmart shopping history or other personal information.
Shoppers can also set spending limits, require approval before purchases, and review orders placed by the agent.
The experience is powered by Walmart’s Agent Gateway, a new system that allows outside AI assistants to connect directly with the retailer’s online store.
While Amazon has taken steps to stop third-party AI agents from making purchases for customers, Walmart is leaning into the idea.
